title: What flower am I? Free flower personality quiz — cv.cm
description: Free flower quiz: answer 12 questions to find out if you're a rose, sunflower, lily, lavender, daisy, orchid, tulip or lotus, and what your flower says about you. No sign-up.
lede: Bold like a rose, sunny like a sunflower or calm like lavender? Answer 12 questions about your days, your friends and your style to find the flower that matches your personality.
about: People have given flowers meanings for thousands of years. In the 1800s whole dictionaries of flower meanings were printed in Europe, so that a bouquet could carry a message: red roses for love, daisies for innocence, sunflowers for loyalty. In Asia the lotus, which rises clean out of muddy water, has long stood for purity and a fresh start. This quiz borrows those well-known meanings to match your personality with one of eight flowers.

Your result names your flower, explains what it says about you and shows your scores for all eight. Flower meanings vary between countries and eras, so read your result as a bit of fun, not a fixed truth. If you like this kind of quiz, try the spirit animal, aura color and color personality quizzes on this site.

faq.a: Rose, sunflower, lily, lavender, daisy, orchid, tulip and lotus.

faq.q: Is one flower rarer than the others?
faq.a: Every flower appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.

faq.q: Where do the flower meanings come from?
faq.a: Mostly from the Victorian language of flowers and from older symbols such as the lotus in Buddhist and Hindu art. Meanings differ from place to place, and this quiz uses the best-known ones.

faq.q: Is this a scientific personality test?
faq.a: No. It's a fun quiz written for cv.cm, and your answers stay in your browser.

rose.name: Rose
rose.body: You are passionate, romantic and full of feeling. You love deeply, you notice beauty and you're not afraid to stand out. Like a rose, you have thorns too: you protect what you love. Your warmth leaves a lasting impression on people.

sunflower.name: Sunflower
sunflower.body: You are warm, loyal and cheerful, and you turn toward the bright side the way sunflowers turn toward the sun. You lift the mood wherever you go, and friends count on your good energy. Remember to rest on cloudy days too.

lily.name: Lily
lily.body: You are graceful, calm and quietly confident. You value honesty, keep your life in good order and treat people with respect. Others admire how you stay composed, and they trust you because you mean what you say.

lavender.name: Lavender
lavender.body: You are gentle, calm and devoted. People feel relaxed around you, and you're the one who soothes a tense room. You value peace and simple pleasures, and you're loyal to the people you love. Make sure you look after yourself as well as you look after others.

daisy.name: Daisy
daisy.body: You are cheerful, open and down to earth. You find joy in small things, make friends easily and never pretend to be someone you're not. Your simple honesty is a breath of fresh air.

orchid.name: Orchid
orchid.body: You are unique, refined and a little mysterious. You have strong taste, a few close friends and a depth that takes time to discover. Orchids look delicate but are tough survivors, and so are you.

tulip.name: Tulip
tulip.body: You are sweet, playful and optimistic, with a love of fresh starts. You show your care in thoughtful ways, you enjoy color and fun, and you bring a spring-like energy to the people around you.

lotus.name: Lotus
lotus.body: You are calm, wise and resilient. Like the lotus that rises clean out of muddy water, you've grown through hard times and come out stronger. You value inner peace and you help others find it too.
